recipient: Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe
title: STP Fiscal Sustainability, Energy Access and Digital Connectivity Development Policy Financing
description: Development Policy Financing (budget-support) operation with two pillars: (i) strengthening SOE oversight and fiscal transparency, and (ii) strengthening energy supply and improving digital connectivity. On the digital side, prior actions increase telecoms-sector competition (results indicator: broadband users rising from a 146,000 baseline in Dec/2025 to a 172,000 target by Dec/2028) and set a target of 150,000 people (thousands, 50% female) with digitally verifiable identification by Dec/2028 against a zero baseline. The operation complements the Digital São Tomé and Príncipe Project (P177158, deal wb-stp-001) and the ASCENT regional energy programme, and is coordinated with an IMF Extended Credit Facility programme approved December 2024.

title: Evaluation of e-governance capacity of Sao Tome and Principe
description: During the project, the e-Governance Academy (EGA) will establish contact points in São Tomé and Príncipe (legal, institutional and technical). EGA will prepare and send out questionnaires to get statistics and brief information about the situation on the ground in STP and the government's future plans. The questionnaire will include questions about the way e-governance is currently organised on the government level and how responsibilities are divided between various government institutions. Issues related to ICT infrastructure as well as legislation and strategy documents are also clarified in the questionnaire.  This phase will be followed by a 1-week mission to the country. In the end of the mission it will be possible to hold a short seminar with all interesting partners and stakeholders to explain the result of the mission. EGA experts will give their first feedback on the mission and give an overview of the Estonian experience in handling similar issues as STP is facing. As a conclusion of the project, EGA will prepare an analytic report describing the situation, next steps, long-run (2-3 years) action plan and approximate budget needed.
